title: crataegus orientalis var. heldreichii
intro: Crataegus orientalis var. heldreichii, commonly known as Oriental Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to support heart health and alleviate symptoms of cardiovascular diseases, such as hypertension and angina. The plant is believed to exert its therapeutic actions through its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to improve cardiovascular function and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Oriental Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its potential health benefits.
